about: Recipe: the two possession models (n4 on the provided ball, rd3n4 on the refined video ball) predict the match on two player inputs - the provided tracking with kit-colour team corrections and players from our own video tracker - and their heads are mixed 0.625 / 0.375 per model before the model blend, the Viterbi decoder and the restart tag layer; nothing is fitted on the match.
decoder_note: null = the merge config's "decoder" block (= #4's decoder; it is applied to #4's member heads to capture its combined heads and residual Viterbi options, mtah.merge_final)

detector.note: YOLO11s ball detector trained on SoccerNet-GSR 2024 + Roboflow Football-Player-Detection only (src/vision/prep_dataset.py, train.py); shipped because its training is not bit-deterministic

refiner.note: Track D TrajDiffusion refiner, all-data model all_v3tied step 20000, trained on external data only (vision.refine.train): simulated evidence on clean IDSSE / PFF / Metrica ball tracks + real detector candidates on SoccerTrack v2 training halves; never on the provided match and never on ISSIA (held-out benchmark only); shipped

ball_video_refD3.npz.content_note: hash of the array the possession model reads (mtah.run_refD.ball_array_refD: xy); the other keys of the file depend on the vision.refine.match version (E148: a rerun with the current code is bit-identical on all 14 ball arrays and adds refD4 keys)

signals_note: main signals {name}.F3.signals.npz = the member on T2team (= R2B2PT's {name}.T2team.signals.npz); {name}.F3.OWN.signals.npz = the same fitted member on the OWN tracking (final_signals --tracking OWN=FILE)

player_fix.about: Track T2 (E182 / E196) corrected provided tracking: team of a track corrected where the kit colour of our player detections contradicts it for a sustained stretch, keeper-kit calls -> team defending that goal (keeper tracks by rule), referee-kit stretches removed; 92 slots (slot 46+s = slot s flipped). Label-free, no slot / frame literals (src/mtah/player_fix.py).

detector.note: E037 YOLO11s person detector trained on SoccerNet-GSR train + Roboflow Football-Player-Detection only (src/vision/prep_players.py, train_players.py; amp, deterministic=False); shipped like the ball detector because its training is not bit-deterministic

expected.note: content_sha256 = run.content_hash over every array (ball, players, team) and is the check; file_sha256 = Track T2's original atd_tactical_T2team.npz (byte-identical rebuild); cands_sha256 = mtah.player_fix.cands_hash of the detections it was built from (logged, diagnostic only)

player_sources.name: OWN
player_sources.about: players purely from our own video tracker (src/mtah/player_fix.py mode OWN = Track P1 build_input OWN): entries with a team, referees / unknown dropped, <= 11 per team by track confidence, a stable slot per identity in the provided slot layout, track ids holding two bodies split by nearest position

tracker.note: Track D4's composed tracker d4h (K2 v7 pieces + re-ID embedding, D4 learned linker, team veto; src/vision/d4track.py, bit-exact port of trackD4/compose/players_video_d4h_k2v7_fbveto.npz): re-ID embeddings from the tactical video (GPU, ~6 min) + tracker (~14 min); reads the player detections of step players (cache/vision/players_cands), the provided tracking and homography
